source: BTS 2024-01 to 2024-03, Origin ATL, completed nondiverted flights
caveats: Flight outcomes and labels are real BTS historical fields; feedback times are reconstructed proxies, NOT recorded label-processing timestamps.
Post hoc exclusion of cancelled/diverted/incomplete flights defines a retrospective completed-flight subpopulation.
Train/calibration selection waits until preceding labels are available, to prevent chronological leakage.
Release event id is the first subsequent prediction-event slot, with end-of-stream labels requiring time-ordered feedback flush.
CSV contains future/outcome fields for delayed-feedback simulation; ONLY prediction_feature_columns may enter the predictor.
